title: Why We Killed Our Multi-Agent Pipeline — Subbiah Sethuraman and Abhilash Asokan, ZS Associates
talk_summary: ZS Associates describes a failed multi-agent pharma analytics pipeline where context was lost across handoffs and no agent owned end-to-end judgment. They replaced distributed reasoning with deterministic signal detection, one reasoning agent plus bounded subagents, and a domain knowledge graph used as a control plane.

takeaways.what_they_do: Consolidate end-to-end judgment in one main agent; spawn subagents only for focused investigation and return results, not reasoning.
takeaways.evidence_quote: need to have one agent, right? Which owns the reasoning end to end

takeaways.what_they_do: Run scripts/statistical checks with thresholds and prioritization to detect signals and queue work; agents investigate queued anomalies rather than deciding what is a signal.
takeaways.evidence_quote: The agent's job is to investigate, not to identify.

takeaways.what_they_do: Build a domain/codebase graph of entities and relationships; the agent traverses edges as hypotheses and stays within bounded paths.
takeaways.evidence_quote: graph has to be treated as a control plane which the agent uses to navigate

takeaways.technique: Prototype with one strong agent before splitting
takeaways.what_they_do: Run one capable coding agent with bash and data access in a sandbox, observe its trajectory, then split only proven deterministic or bounded subtasks.
takeaways.evidence_quote: Then started observing what it is doing.

takeaways.technique: Derive topology from work, not human org chart
takeaways.what_they_do: Do not encode human organizational constraints into agent architecture; let required deterministic/agentic boundaries determine topology.
takeaways.evidence_quote: we should not be introducing human constraints or design constraints into architecture

takeaways.technique: Tool for repeated function-writing and querying
takeaways.what_they_do: Give the agent a tool to write functions and query the database repeatedly instead of splitting each query step into a separate agent.
takeaways.evidence_quote: we give it a tool for that
